links.outcome: Expert-rated ChatGPT-4o tumor board recommendation quality across five domains versus maximum score
links.effect: Scores were significantly lower than the maximum of 1.0 across all five criteria (all p < 0.0001); discrepancies in treatment sequencing and chemotherapy selection.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o scores were significantly lower than the maximum achievable value of 1.0 across all five criteria (all p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating ChatGPT-4o's performance on soft tissue sarcoma tumor board decisions compared to expert MDT decisions without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
